checkpoints.look_for: any dollar amount, percentage, or fee reference in bot output. Even 'around $X' counts.

bot claims a bookable trial program that is NOT one of: Adult Fundamentals BJJ, Kids Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu (3-6), Kids Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu (7-13). The following are REAL Montgomery BJJ programs in the verified KB (non-bookable / specialty / no separate trial calendar) and must NOT be flagged as hallucinations: Gi, No-Gi, Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu, Leg Locks, ADCC No-Gi, Kids Competition Class, Open Mat, Fundamentals, All Levels. Only flag source-bleed program names from OTHER gyms (e.g. Vacaville, Bodega, Gracie, Logica, Sugoi, Fun Jitsu, Muay Thai, Boxing).
bot says 'you're all set', 'you're booked', or similar confirmation WITHOUT the booking tool returning success first.
bot says 'I don't currently have', 'let me check' where it should give a firm known answer (e.g. under-3 not bookable, specialty/open-mat not an online trial).
bot output contains unreplaced tokens like {{contact.first_name}}, UNRESOLVED(contact.phone), {{variable}}.

checkpoints.description: Asks who the class is for before personal info

bot asks date of birth (not just age) for each enrollee before the booking tool fires.

ages 3-6 -> Kids Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu (3-6); ages 7-13 -> Kids Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu (7-13); ages 14-17 NOT booked (team follow-up); under 3 NOT booked (phone referral (609) 355-7500). Cross-band routing is a mis-route.

if lead pushes pricing 2+ times, bot firmly redirects to the free trial / staff. Never gives a number.

checkpoints.description: Unaccompanied minor handled as referral, not booking
checkpoints.look_for: lead under 18 with no parent/guardian involved on the adult self-book path: bot must NOT book. Capture name + DOB + parent contact, close with team-will-follow-up.
